say:1:1525502001:1.source_cn: 来得正好，有件事交给你去做。
say:1:1525502001:1.male: Perfect timing. I was just looking for someone to unload this mess onto.
say:1:1525502001:1.female: Perfect timing. I was just looking for someone to unload this mess onto.

say:3:1525502003:2.text: Simple. <style="highlight">Go to Halia and set up this magic circle to stop the rain.</style>
say:3:1525502003:2.male: Simple. <style="highlight">Go to Halia and set up this magic circle to stop the rain.</style>
say:3:1525502003:2.female: Simple. <style="highlight">Go to Halia and set up this magic circle to stop the rain.</style>

say:4:1525502004:1.text: If this rain keeps going, even the Regulus' palace might drown. I don't want to deal with that.
say:4:1525502004:1.source_cn: 这场雨要是继续下下去，只怕连那位小领主的宫殿也会被淹没...
say:4:1525502004:1.male: If this rain keeps going, even the Regulus' palace might drown. I don't want to deal with that.
say:4:1525502004:1.female: If this rain keeps going, even the Regulus' palace might drown. I don't want to deal with that.

choice_prompt:6:1525502004.text: If this rain keeps going, even the Regulus' palace might drown. I don't want to deal with that.
choice_prompt:6:1525502004.source_cn: 这场雨要是继续下下去，只怕连那位小领主的宫殿也会被淹没。我可不想再处理那种惨烈的场景。
choice_prompt:6:1525502004.male: If this rain keeps going, even the Regulus' palace might drown. I don't want to deal with that.
choice_prompt:6:1525502004.female: If this rain keeps going, even the Regulus' palace might drown. I don't want to deal with that.

say:8:1525502006:1.text: And besides, that old scholar in Halia hates me. Better you than me.
say:8:1525502006:1.source_cn: 而且呼临城那个老学究很敌视我，你出面比较方便。
say:8:1525502006:1.male: And besides, that old scholar in Halia hates me. Better you than me.
say:8:1525502006:1.female: And besides, that old scholar in Halia hates me. Better you than me.

say:9:1525502007:1.text: Don't worry, I'll go with you. If things get ugly, I'll step in and deal with Halia's finest for you.
say:9:1525502007:1.source_cn: 不过放心，我会和你一起去，必要的时候帮你和呼临人吵架。
say:9:1525502007:1.male: Don't worry, I'll go with you. If things get ugly, I'll step in and deal with Halia's finest for you.
say:9:1525502007:1.female: Don't worry, I'll go with you. If things get ugly, I'll step in and deal with Halia's finest for you.

choice_prompt:10:1525502007.text: Don't worry, I'll go with you. If things get ugly, I'll step in and deal with Halia's finest for you.
choice_prompt:10:1525502007.source_cn: 不过放心，我会和你一起去，必要的时候帮你和呼临人吵架。
choice_prompt:10:1525502007.male: Don't worry, I'll go with you. If things get ugly, I'll step in and deal with Halia's finest for you.
choice_prompt:10:1525502007.female: Don't worry, I'll go with you. If things get ugly, I'll step in and deal with Halia's finest for you.

say:11:1525502008:1.text: Yeah, because I'm allergic to letting idiots speak unchallenged. But I'll control myself. If someone else throws the first punch, that's on them.
say:11:1525502008:1.source_cn: 我会克制自己，但别人怎么做就不归我管了。
say:11:1525502008:1.male: Yeah, because I'm allergic to letting idiots speak unchallenged. But I'll control myself. If someone else throws the first punch, that's on them.
say:11:1525502008:1.female: Yeah, because I'm allergic to letting idiots speak unchallenged. But I'll control myself. If someone else throws the first punch, that's on them.

say:12:1525502010:1.text: Come on. I need to walk the young Regulus through how this magic circle works before someone starts screaming that I'm plotting their doom again.
say:12:1525502010:1.source_cn: 走吧，去呼临城。我得和那位小领主解释魔法阵的原理，免得...
say:12:1525502010:1.male: Come on. I need to walk the young Regulus through how this magic circle works before someone starts screaming that I'm plotting their doom again.
say:12:1525502010:1.female: Come on. I need to walk the young Regulus through how this magic circle works before someone starts screaming that I'm plotting their doom again.

choice:10:0:1.text: You always start fights! Not me!
choice:10:0:1.male: You always start fights! Not me!
choice:10:0:1.female: You always start fights! Not me!

say:14:1525502009:1.text: I love your optimism—thinking you get a say.
say:14:1525502009:1.male: I love your optimism—thinking you get a say.
say:14:1525502009:1.female: I love your optimism—thinking you get a say.

choice:10:1:2.text: Thanks, but I think I'll pass...
choice:10:1:2.male: Thanks, but I think I'll pass...
choice:10:1:2.female: Thanks, but I think I'll pass...

choice:6:0:1.text: Why don't you do it yourself?
choice:6:0:1.male: Why don't you do it yourself?
choice:6:0:1.female: Why don't you do it yourself?

choice:6:1:2.text: You really need me for something this tiny?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 这么简单的事还要找我？
choice:6:1:2.male: You really need me for something this tiny?
choice:6:1:2.female: You really need me for something this tiny?

say:15:1525502002:1.text: If you had any power to say no, you wouldn't be here at all.
say:15:1525502002:1.source_cn: 你要是有能力拒绝，根本就不会被我召唤回来。
say:15:1525502002:1.male: If you had any power to say no, you wouldn't be here at all.
say:15:1525502002:1.female: If you had any power to say no, you wouldn't be here at all.

say:0:1525502501:0.text: Don't just stand there. Let's move. Halia won't save itself.
say:0:1525502501:0.source_cn: 别愣着了，我们现在就去呼临。

say:1:1525504001:1.text: Mages! Please, tell me you've found a way to help Halia.
say:1:1525504001:1.source_cn: 两位魔法师，你们找到帮助呼临的方法了吗？

say:3:1525504002:2.text: This magic circle will stop the rain. Pick a spot and set it up.
say:3:1525504002:2.source_cn: 这个魔法阵可以驱散呼临城的降雨。找个地方布置吧。

say:8:1525504005:1.text: Last time you people cast a circle, we got a flood! How do we know this won't be worse?!
say:8:1525504005:1.source_cn: 你们协会上次用魔法阵引来了洪水！谁知道这次会发生什么？

say:9:1525504006:0.text: Stubborn old man. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you explain it.
say:9:1525504006:0.male: Stubborn old man. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you explain it.
say:9:1525504006:0.female: Stubborn old man. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you explain it.

choice_prompt:10:1525504006.text: Stubborn old man. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you explain it.
choice_prompt:10:1525504006.male: Stubborn old man. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you explain it.
choice_prompt:10:1525504006.female: Stubborn old man. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you explain it.

say:11:1525504007:1.text: But you did cause a flood, which shows just how reckless you were.
say:11:1525504007:1.source_cn: 但你确实引来了洪水，这已经足够说明你们过于冒进。
say:11:1525504007:1.male: But you did cause a flood, which shows just how reckless you were.
say:11:1525504007:1.female: But you did cause a flood, which shows just how reckless you were.

say:13:1525504010:1.text: Master Bakis, <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never do anything to hurt us!
say:13:1525504010:1.male: Master Bakis, <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never do anything to hurt us!
say:13:1525504010:1.female: Master Bakis, <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never do anything to hurt us!

say:14:1525504011:1.text: You've seen him running all over the place trying to help us.
say:14:1525504011:1.male: You've seen him running all over the place trying to help us.
say:14:1525504011:1.female: You've seen her running all over the place trying to help us.

say:15:1525504012:1.text: But her fellow mage is an evil criminal!
say:15:1525504012:1.male: But her fellow mage is an evil criminal!
say:15:1525504012:1.female: But her fellow mage is an evil criminal!

say:16:1525504013:1.text: My lord, please! Don't stake Halia's future on someone like Morgan!
say:16:1525504013:1.source_cn: 殿下，请慎重考虑！呼临城绝不能将未来押在摩根这种人手上！

say:17:1525504014:1.text: With scholars like you, it's a miracle Halia has a future at all.
say:17:1525504014:1.source_cn: 有你这样的学者，呼临城才是真的没有未来。

say:21:1525504016:0.text: That's right. I trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>... and Morgan.
say:21:1525504016:0.male: That's right. I trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>... and Morgan.
say:21:1525504016:0.female: That's right. I trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>... and Morgan.

say:22:1525504018:0.text: Master Bakis... if there's even a chance this stops people from dying, then I have to try it.
say:22:1525504018:0.source_cn: 比博老师，无论用什么样的方式，只要能够阻止死伤，我……...

say:23:1525504019:0.text: It's my responsibility as the Regulus of Halia. If anything goes wrong, I'll take full responsibility.
say:23:1525504019:0.source_cn: 这是我身为呼临城领主的职责。如果有意外，我来承担一切责任。

say:24:1525504020:1.text: But my lord... Halia won't survive another disaster.
say:24:1525504020:1.source_cn: 可是殿下，呼临城已经没有余力再承受一次失败了。

choice_prompt:25:1525504020.text: But my lord... Halia won't survive another disaster.
choice_prompt:25:1525504020.source_cn: 可是殿下，呼临城已经没有余力再承受一次失败了。

say:26:1525504021:1.text: ... Fine. Then you will cast it, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:26:1525504021:1.male: ... Fine. Then you will cast it, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:26:1525504021:1.female: ... Fine. Then you will cast it, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:27:1525504022:1.text: And Morgan stays out of every step. I'll be right there watching to make sure of it.
say:27:1525504022:1.source_cn: 流程中任何一道步骤都禁止摩根插手。我会在一旁监督你。
say:27:1525504022:1.male: And Morgan stays out of every step. I'll be right there watching to make sure of it.
say:27:1525504022:1.female: And Morgan stays out of every step. I'll be right there watching to make sure of it.

say:29:1525504023:1.text: Brilliant. In that case, I'm taking a nap.

choice_prompt:30:1525504023.text: Brilliant. In that case, I'm taking a nap.

narration:33:1525504026:0.text: With Abundius and Bakis watching closely, you draw the magic circle that should end the rain.
narration:33:1525504026:0.source_cn: 在阿邦德和比博的注视下，你描绘出了驱雨魔法阵
narration:33:1525504026:0.male: With Abundius and Bakis watching closely, you draw the magic circle that should end the rain.
narration:33:1525504026:0.female: With Abundius and Bakis watching closely, you draw the magic circle that should end the rain.

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 这是你早就算好的吧，摩根

choice:25:1:2.text: The circle will work, I promise!
choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 这次的法阵绝不会出错！
choice:25:1:2.male: The circle will work, I promise!
choice:25:1:2.female: The circle will work, I promise!

choice:20:0:1.text: Abundius asked us to handle this.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 这是阿邦德拜托我们的事
choice:20:0:1.male: Abundius asked us to handle this.
choice:20:0:1.female: Abundius asked us to handle this.

choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 你该不会是想质疑领主的决策吧？

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 我来为摩根的魔法阵做担保

say:40:1525504009:1.text: He's the one I don't trust—Morgan!
say:40:1525504009:1.male: He's the one I don't trust—Morgan!
say:40:1525504009:1.female: He's the one I don't trust—Morgan!

say:0:1525505001:0.text: The rain stopped! Master Bakis, look!

say:1:1525506001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Thank you! The rain stopped. Halia is safe!
say:1:1525506001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Thank you! The rain stopped. Halia is safe!
say:1:1525506001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Thank you! The rain stopped. Halia is safe!

say:2:1525506002:1.text: And, uh... thank you too, Morgan. Your magic really is something.
say:2:1525506002:1.source_cn: 呃，还有……谢谢你，摩根。你的魔法太神奇了！

say:4:1525506003:1.text: Don't thank me. He cast the spell.
say:4:1525506003:1.male: Don't thank me. He cast the spell.
say:4:1525506003:1.female: Don't thank me. She cast the spell.

choice_prompt:5:1525506003.text: Don't thank me. He cast the spell.
choice_prompt:5:1525506003.male: Don't thank me. He cast the spell.
choice_prompt:5:1525506003.female: Don't thank me. She cast the spell.

say:6:1525506004:1.text: "Designed" is a bit dramatic. Come on, we've still got a mountain of work waiting for us.
say:6:1525506004:1.source_cn: 没有“特地”。走吧，还有一堆活等着我们呢。
say:6:1525506004:1.male: "Designed" is a bit dramatic. Come on, we've still got a mountain of work waiting for us.
say:6:1525506004:1.female: "Designed" is a bit dramatic. Come on, we've still got a mountain of work waiting for us.

say:7:1525506005:1.text: Please, wait, mages! On behalf of Halia, I want to thank—
say:7:1525506005:1.source_cn: 请等一下，两位魔法师！我代表呼临城感谢——

say:8:1525506006:1.text: Skip the formalities. Just send help quickly when I call for it.
say:8:1525506006:1.source_cn: 客套话就免了吧。等我叫你们帮忙时，记得及时派人来。

say:10:1525506007:1.text: You really did stop the rain...

say:11:1525506008:1.text: No need to restate the obvious.
say:11:1525506008:1.source_cn: 没必要把事实重复一遍。

say:12:1525506009:1.text: Fair enough. The truth is, Morgan, you helped Halia today.
say:12:1525506009:1.source_cn: 就事实而言，这次你确实帮助了呼临城，摩根。

say:16:1525506012:1.text: Please accept the lord's thanks. Halia still has a lot to deal with, so we won't keep you any longer.
say:16:1525506012:1.source_cn: 请收下殿下的感谢吧。呼临城仍有许多事务亟需处理，我们就...

say:18:1525506013:1.text: Right, now that the rain's stopped, the locusts will ease up too. Our soldiers can finally catch their breath.
say:18:1525506013:1.source_cn: 嗯、对！雨停了，蝗虫也会少一些，士兵们可以喘息一段时日。

say:19:1525506014:1.text: If you ever need help, just say the word!
say:19:1525506014:1.source_cn: 等你们需要帮忙时，尽管跟我说就好！

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 魔法阵可是你特地做的
